question: What public reset-start config shape should OpenClaw support for customizing reset prompt text across root config, per-agent overrides, bootstrap-aware prompts, and acknowledgement-only reset behavior?
rationale: This adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes session-start semantics, so automation should not invent a key or bypass current bootstrap safeguards without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Choose a single typed policy covering prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs.

options.title: Narrow To Prompt Text
options.body: Add only a prompt-text override while preserving the current acknowledgement-only default and documenting bootstrap/current-time precedence.

options.title: Defer New Config
options.body: Keep the hardcoded prompt for now and route customization through the broader reset greeting policy discussion first.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Choose a single typed policy covering prompt text, startup-turn behavior, current-time/bootstrap preservation, and future greeting/model knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses reset command behavior, config compatibility, and current maintainer-reviewed reset policy, and this handle has recent reset-command history.
